verdict: Lead flow stalled; intake coverage gap is now the critical fix.
narrative: This period, Google Ads ran near-dark for four of the last five days — spending effectively $0 on multiple days — which drove a 50% drop in leads week over week and left you with just 1 lead in the most recent 7-day stretch. At the same time, your pipeline shows 76 opportunities created in the last 28 days with zero booked jobs, which points to an intake processing problem rather than an advertising one. The dispatch seat that went vacant on July 7th has left lead response coverage unconfirmed for over 30 days, and any leads arriving may not be reaching a live person in time to convert. Google spend is being restored, and the intake coverage and lead-response process are being confirmed and corrected this week. Once both are resolved, the pipeline volume already present gives you a realistic path to booked jobs without waiting for new leads to rebuild.

highlights.phrase: lead received in the last 7 days, down from 2 the week prior
opportunities in your pipeline this period with zero converting to booked jobs
average cost per lead over the last 28 days

watch_item.issue: The dispatch seat vacant since July 7th has left lead intake and after-hours response uncovered for over 30 days, meaning paid leads may be arriving with no one to answer them.
watch_item.fix: Confirming the new intake owner, updating lead-response routing, and verifying after-hours coverage are all in motion this week.
